limits.n: Draft depth 19.8 m (infobox, citing Findaport); 15 berths load ships of 25,000 to 320,000 dwt (Port Hedland Port Authority handbook, cited by the article)

classes.basis: The 320,000 dwt limit is in the VLOC band (200,000 to 400,000 dwt).

Its standard vessel is within every limit given; the next larger class compared, VLOC, has a 22 m draught. Newcastlemax, between the two in size, has no standard vessel in the atlas and cannot be ruled out.

maxClass.n: Atlas estimate, derived from the limits the page gives; not the port's own statement. limits.n: Three single buoy moorings designed for ships of up to 700,000 deadweight tons (635,000 tonnes)

classes.basis: The 635,000 dwt limit is above the VLCC band (200,000 to 320,000 dwt), the largest of the segment.

maxClass.n: Atlas estimate, derived from the limits the page gives; not the port's own statement. By deadweight: the class whose size band holds the deadweight limit ("or larger" above the largest band; where bands overlap, the widest). By dimensions: the largest class whose standard vessel is no larger than the draught, length and beam given. No class from a depth alone. A larger ship may call part-laden, at another berth or with the tide.
